name: Skinbark
subtitle: Fladrif
game_text:
Skinbark’s twilight cost is −1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.
<phase>Response</phase>: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.
flavor_text: “‘He has gone up onto the high places, among the birches that he loves best....’”
